statement: SYNTHETIC DemoQueue configuration incident; assess internal fixture consistency only, not a real-world incident.
timeline: On 2026-10-01 UTC, queue submissions failed at 10:05, alert fired 10:06, reproduction at 10:08, fix at 10:15, recovery 10:18 and clean observation through 10:25.
root_cause: The configuration rollout allowed queue_capacity=0 without startup validation, causing all enqueue operations to reject.
remediation: Restore capacity to 100 and reject capacities below 1 at startup; regression tests demonstrate zero and negative rejection and acceptance for capacities 1 and 100.
